title: A Power Outage at Home
paragraphs: In the middle of cooking dinner, the electricity suddenly went out across the whole neighborhood, leaving Hadi's family sitting in the dark kitchen with half of their meal still uncooked on the stove.
Instead of panicking, Hadi's wife lit a few candles they kept in a drawer for exactly this situation, while he checked with neighbors to see whether the outage was affecting the entire street.
They finished cooking a simplified version of dinner on a small gas burner they rarely used, and the children found the candlelight dinner surprisingly exciting rather than inconvenient.

When the power finally returned two hours later, Hadi's family agreed that the unplanned candlelit dinner, though inconvenient at first, had actually turned into one of their more memorable evenings that month.
